findings.title: 前端不把 USER_DISABLED 401 当会话结束
findings.why_it_matters:
T0-B 让后端在 actor 层每请求判 `users.status` ⇒ 停用用户下一次请求即 401 `USER_DISABLED`（pcs-backend/app/api/v1/config.py:565 新增）。但前端唯一的 401 处理路径是 axios 拦截器里的 `SESSION_OVER_CODES`（client.ts:24-31，只含 MISSING_BEARER / INVALID_TOKEN / EXPIRED_TOKEN / WRONG_TOKEN_TYPE / INVALID_REFRESH / EXPIRED_REFRESH）⇒ 该响应**带 code** 且不在集合里 ⇒ 拦截器条件 `if (!code || SESSION_OVER_CODES.has(code))` 为假 ⇒ 既不 `clearSession()` 也不跳 `/login` ⇒ 被停用的用户带着在手 token 停在任意业务页，之后每个请求都 401，页面只剩通用错误提示（「加载物流列表失败」），永远回不到登录页，也永远不知道自己被停用了。

SPEC §7.1（V2.12，**本批新增**）明写「前端按**普通 401** 处理（跳登录页）」⇒ 实现没兑现，SPEC 与实现不一致（仓库根 CLAUDE.md：前端以 SPEC 为唯一编码依据 ⇒ 消费者按 SPEC 写代码会写错）。前端全库 grep 无任何 `USER_DISABLED` 处理（唯二命中是审计动作名与 openapi 文档文本）；本批的浏览器回归（QA 报告 §2.1~§2.5）也从未走过这条路径。

pcs-frontend/src/api/client.ts:24-31 — `const SESSION_OVER_CODES = new Set([ 'MISSING_BEARER', 'INVALID_TOKEN', 'EXPIRED_TOKEN', 'WRONG_TOKEN_TYPE', 'INVALID_REFRESH', 'EXPIRED_REFRESH' ]);`（无 USER_DISABLED）

docs/PCS-UI-SPEC.md V2.12 — 「**下一次请求**返 **401 `USER_DISABLED`** ⇒ 前端按**普通 401** 处理（跳登录页）」

pcs-frontend/src/api/client.ts:39 - `      if (!code || SESSION_OVER_CODES.has(code)) {` (the set at lines 24-31 contains MISSING_BEARER / INVALID_TOKEN / EXPIRED_TOKEN / WRONG_TOKEN_TYPE / INVALID_REFRESH / EXPIRED_REFRESH only - no USER_DISABLED, no REFRESH_REVOKED)

Trigger: admin disables user X (PUT /admin/users/{id}/disable -> users.status = DISABLED); user X still holds an unexpired access token in the browser. Path: any API call -> current_actor -> is_account_disabled() -> True -> PcsError(code="USER_DISABLED", status=401) -> axios response interceptor -> status 401, body.code = "USER_DISABLED" -> `!code` is False and SESSION_OVER_CODES.has("USER_DISABLED") is False -> clearSession() and the /login redirect are both skipped -> the promise is rejected to the caller as an ordinary error. Outcome: the UI keeps the stale token, keeps showing the disabled user as signed in with their old role, and every page action fails; the user is never told the account was disabled.

findings.title: Lineage endpoints bypass streams role gate (CWE-862)
findings.why_it_matters: Every endpoint in app/api/v1/streams.py gates on require_roles(user, "DESIGNER", "PROCESS_CONTROLLER", "SYSTEM_ADMIN") — GET /streams/{id} included (streams.py:443). The three lineage endpoints gate only on a valid token plus project membership (has_project_access); they never call require_roles (verified: lineage.py's import line is `from app.api.v1.config import _Actor, current_actor` — no require_roles anywhere in the file). Before this diff the streams record_type branch of /graph and /downstream always ended in 404 (data_lineage never contains record_type='streams' — the diff's own docstring says so), so the lineage path exposed nothing about a stream. This diff adds the streams branch with a synthetic root that serializes the stream's own fields (source, created_by, created_at) plus the downstream calc-lineage rows (record_type/record_id/change_summary/actor_user_id). A project member holding a role outside the streams allow-list (REVIEWER is an LDAP-mapped role in the default ldap_group_role_map; CHECKER and VIEWER are in current_actor's _ALLOWED_ROLES) gets 403 on GET /streams/{id} but 200 with stream metadata and calc-lineage content from GET /lineage/streams/{id}/graph. That is a broken-access-control path around a role gate that the owning module deliberately applies.
evidence: pcs-backend/app/api/v1/lineage.py:137 — `    user: Annotated[_Actor, Depends(current_actor)],` (the /graph endpoint's only authz: current_actor + project guard; no require_roles anywhere in lineage.py — grep for require_roles in that file returns nothing, and its import line is `from app.api.v1.config import _Actor, current_actor`)

pcs-backend/app/api/v1/streams.py:443 — `    require_roles(user, "DESIGNER", "PROCESS_CONTROLLER", "SYSTEM_ADMIN")` (get_stream's role gate; the same call appears on every one of the 18 streams endpoints)

pcs-backend/app/api/v1/lineage.py:320 — `        "source": stream.source,` (new synthetic root serializes stream fields; lineage.py:323 — `        "actor_user_id": str(stream.created_by) if stream.created_by else None,`)

diff-backend-app.txt new branch in graph(): `+    if record_type == "streams":` → `+        return await _stream_graph(session, record_id, max_depth=max_depth)` — pre-diff this path fell through to tracker.latest(record_type='streams') which finds no rows and raises 404, i.e. the diff is what first makes stream data reachable through the lineage module

pcs-backend/app/api/v1/lineage.py:190 — `        "change_summary": lineage.change_summary,` — the downstream rows returned by the new streams branch carry free-text change summaries and calc record ids
findings.first_evidence: pcs-backend/app/api/v1/lineage.py:137 — `    user: Annotated[_Actor, Depends(current_actor)],` (the /graph endpoint's only authz: current_actor + project guard; no require_roles anywhere in lineage.py)
findings.suggested_fix: Add the same role gate the streams module applies to the lineage endpoints, e.g. in app/api/v1/lineage.py add `from app.api.v1.config import require_roles` and call `require_roles(user, "DESIGNER", "PROCESS_CONTROLLER", "SYSTEM_ADMIN")` at the top of upstream(), downstream() and graph() (before _guard_record_access, so the guard stays the outermost check per the batch's hard constraint). Assumption: the intended role model for the lineage surface is the streams-module allow-list; if the product instead intends any project member to read lineage, then the streams endpoints' role list is the thing to reconcile — either way the two surfaces should agree, and the choice should be recorded in docs/PCS-UI-SPEC.md §7.7.2. The fail-closed 404 shape for cross-project/unknown-type must stay byte-identical after the change.

findings.title: Same lineage row serialized two ways across sibling endpoints
findings.why_it_matters: Only /graph moved to the named schema; /upstream and /downstream still declare response_model=list[dict], so one DataLineage row crosses two different serializers. (a) Timestamp representation: /graph now round-trips occurred_at through pydantic (datetime -> '2026-09-15T14:00:00Z'), while /upstream and /downstream keep _serialize's raw isoformat ('2026-09-15T14:00:00+00:00'). The same row therefore reports two different timestamp strings depending on the endpoint, and /graph's string changed relative to its pre-diff raw-dict response (a visible, undocumented value change on an existing endpoint that external scripts consume — the batch's own test comment calls /downstream 'a public endpoint (external scripts will hit it)'). (b) Silent field loss: LineageGraphResponse ignores unknown keys, so any field later added to _serialize (e.g. actor_ai_agent_id / record_hash_at_track, which exist on the model) appears on /upstream and /downstream but vanishes from /graph with no error — precisely the silent divergence this batch set out to remove by introducing the named schema. The frontend's contract-derived LineageNode type is only guaranteed for /graph.
evidence: pcs-backend/app/api/v1/lineage.py:45 — `@router.get("/{record_type}/{record_id}/upstream", response_model=list[dict])`
pcs-backend/app/api/v1/lineage.py:84 — `@router.get("/{record_type}/{record_id}/downstream", response_model=list[dict])`
pcs-backend/app/api/v1/lineage.py:133 — `@router.get("/{record_type}/{record_id}/graph", response_model=LineageGraphResponse)`
pcs-backend/app/api/v1/lineage.py:196 — `        "occurred_at": lineage.occurred_at.isoformat() if lineage.occurred_at else None,`
pcs-backend/app/schemas/lineage.py:87 — `    occurred_at: datetime | None = Field(None, description="发生时间（ISO 8601）")`

Measured with the repo's own environment (pcs-backend/.venv, pydantic 2.13.5, fastapi 0.141.1): `datetime(2026,9,15,14,0,0,tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat()` → '2026-09-15T14:00:00+00:00' whereas a pydantic model with field `t: datetime | None` serializes to '{"t":"2026-09-15T14:00:00Z"}' ⇒ the /graph representation differs from the /upstream|/downstream representation.
findings.suggested_fix: Give all three lineage endpoints one node schema: change /upstream and /downstream to `response_model=list[LineageNode]` (import LineageNode next to LineageGraphResponse in app/api/v1/lineage.py) so every row crosses the same response model — that removes both the dual representation and the silent-drop hazard (a field added to _serialize must be added to LineageNode, and it then survives on all three endpoints). Note this changes the timestamp string on /upstream and /downstream from '+00:00' to 'Z'; that is the intended convergence. If byte-identical timestamps to the old raw output must be preserved, type occurred_at as `str | None` in LineageNode instead of `datetime` so the schema stops re-formatting the value.

findings.title: WS 握手：DB 异常逃出 except PcsError ⇒ 500 而非 1008
findings.why_it_matters:
P9B-4 T0-B 把一次 DB 读（users.status）带进了 WebSocket 握手鉴权路径。ws.py 的握手错误处理只捕获 PcsError（缺 token / JWT 无效 / USER_DISABLED）⇒ DB 连接错误、连接池 30s 超时（pool_timeout=30）、语句超时抛的都是 SQLAlchemy 异常，不是 PcsError ⇒ 逃出 handler ⇒ 握手以未处理的异常结束（ASGI 服务器回 HTTP 500），而不是模块 docstring 承诺的「握手阶段鉴权失败 ⇒ 直接关连接（1008）」。模块里那条 `except Exception` 兜底在 accept() 之后的接收循环里，覆盖不到握手阶段 ⇒ 运维在 WS 模块里看不到任何一行日志。

后果：一次 DB 抖动表现为「WS 连不上」而非「鉴权后端不可用」，客户端也无法区分「被拒」与「后端坏了」；这条路径同时把通知通道与 DB 的可用性绑死了（此前握手是纯 CPU 的 JWT 解码，与 DB 无关）。
evidence: pcs-backend/app/api/v1/ws.py:96 — `    except PcsError as e:`
pcs-backend/app/api/v1/ws.py:77-78 — `    async with factory() as session:` / `        actor = await current_actor(session, authorization)`（握手路径现在会做一次 DB 读）

pcs-backend/app/api/v1/config.py — `    if await is_account_disabled(db, user_id=user_id):` → pcs-backend/app/services/user_status_service.py — `        await session.execute(` / `            select(User.status).where(User.user_id == user_id)` ⇒ DB 异常从这里冒出来，它不是 PcsError
pcs-backend/app/api/v1/ws.py:113 — `    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — 任何异常都必须摘掉 sink，否则泄漏` —— 这条兜底在 accept() 之后，覆盖不到握手阶段
findings.suggested_fix:
在握手的 except PcsError 之后补一条非业务异常的兜底，让失败形状与既有约定一致（同样在 accept() 之前 close，与现有 PcsError 分支同形）：

    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 —— 鉴权现在依赖 DB ⇒ DB 抖动也会到这
        logger.exception("通知 WS 握手：鉴权后端不可用")
        await websocket.close(code=_WS_POLICY_VIOLATION, reason="AUTH_UNAVAILABLE")
        return

假设：前端把任何非 1000 的关闭都按「连不上」处理（现有前端在握手失败时即如此），因此用 1008 + reason="AUTH_UNAVAILABLE" 关闭与现有 PcsError 分支行为一致。若希望区分「被拒」与「后端不可用」，可另加一个关闭码，但那是前端契约变更，需另行评估。

findings.title: Deployment assertion goes green while mock-login route is mounted
findings.why_it_matters:
assert_mock_auth_not_exposed is a deployment guard whose stated invariant is 'the mock router must not be mounted in production'. The rewrite correctly replaced the app.routes walk (which FastAPI 0.141's lazy mounting made a no-op), but it swapped one proxy for another: it now asserts on the OpenAPI schema, which is a *derived view* of the routing table and is empty for any route excluded from the schema. A single plausible edit — including the mock router with include_in_schema=False so it stops showing up in /docs — makes the assertion pass while /auth/mock-login is mounted and reachable. The production double gate inside the endpoint still refuses to issue a token, so this is not a live bypass today; but the assertion that is supposed to fail fast on a mis-mounted router no longer fails, i.e. the guard this batch rewrote as a silent-pass fix is still a silent-pass.

Independently verified: the OpenAPI-path check is version-independent for this failure mode — include_router(..., include_in_schema=False) keeps the route out of `app.openapi()['paths']` on both FastAPI 0.135 and 0.141.1 — so the finding does not depend on the version question raised about the comment above it (pcs-backend/uv.lock pins fastapi 0.141.1; the system interpreter has 0.135.3).
evidence: pcs-backend/app/main.py:53 - `    paths = app.openapi().get("paths", {})` followed by `    if any(path.endswith("/mock-login") for path in paths):` - the whole 'is the route mounted' decision is made on the OpenAPI schema.

Mechanically verified on the installed stack (fastapi 0.141.1): `app.include_router(mock_auth_router, include_in_schema=False)` -> `app.openapi()['paths']` is `[]` while `TestClient(app).post('/auth/mock-login')` returns **200** with the route's payload. Trigger: someone mounts the mock router with include_in_schema=False (the natural way to hide a dev-only route from /docs); path: openapi paths contain no '/mock-login' -> the `any(...)` check is False -> no RuntimeError; outcome: production starts successfully with the mock-login route mounted - exactly the state the assertion exists to prevent, reported as green.

For contrast, the previous check was also a proxy: on fastapi 0.141.1 `app.routes` after include_router contains `('_IncludedRouter', None)` - an object with no `path` attribute - so `getattr(route, "path", "").endswith("/mock-login")` never matched. Both the old and the new assertion read a derived view rather than the routing table.

pcs-backend/app/main.py:44-47 - the other half of the guard (`if settings.enable_mock_login: raise RuntimeError(...)`) still fires independently, and pcs-backend/app/api/v1/mock_auth.py:57 (`if settings.is_production or not settings.enable_mock_login:`) still refuses to issue a token in production - which is why this is not an active auth bypass.
findings.first_evidence: pcs-backend/app/main.py:53 - `    paths = app.openapi().get("paths", {})` followed by `    if any(path.endswith("/mock-login") for path in paths):` - the whole 'is the route mounted' decision is made on the OpenAPI schema.
findings.suggested_fix: Assert on the routing table instead of the schema: keep the OpenAPI check but add a walk of app.routes that resolves FastAPI 0.141's `_IncludedRouter` wrapper (e.g. `router = getattr(route, "original_router", None)` then check `getattr(r, "path", "")` over `router.routes`) and raise if any path ends with '/mock-login'. Add a regression test that mounts the mock router with include_in_schema=False and asserts the guard still raises - the current test only covers the schema-visible case, so it cannot catch this divergence.

findings.title: Fail-closed lineage guard makes PSV lineage permanently 404
findings.why_it_matters:
T0-D turned the lineage guard fail-closed: any record_type that is not in the guard registry now returns 404 instead of falling through. The registry is derived from RECORD_TYPE_REGISTRY, but that registry does not contain PsvResult — yet PsvResult is exactly one of the models that writes lineage rows (finalize_calc_record in psv_persist). Before this diff the guard skipped unregistered types, so GET /lineage/PsvResult/{id}/graph resolved the real lineage; after it, the same request is a hard 404 for every PSV record.

Independently verified in this repo: (a) `grep -n PsvResult app/services/calc_lineage.py` ⇒ 0 hits (the 21 registry keys are PipingResult, PumpResult, FlashResult, PipeNetworkResult, TwoPhaseResult, ReliefResult, ColumnSizingResult, MixerResult, ProjectCalculationStandardProfile, HeatResult, VesselResult, SepEquipResult, cv_result, restriction_result, flare_system_result, cooling_tower_result, psychro_result, OpenChannelResult, FiltrationResult, CostEstResult, ThermosiphonCirculationResult); (b) `app/services/psv/psv_persist.py:444` calls `finalize_calc_record` ⇒ `LineageTracker.track` writes `record_type=record.__class__.__name__` (app/services/lineage.py:109) ⇒ real `data_lineage` rows with record_type='PsvResult' exist; (c) PsvResult has `project_id` (declared_attr on RecordMixin, app/models/mixins.py) ⇒ it *could* be registered.

⇒ The derivation inherits a pre-existing gap in RECORD_TYPE_REGISTRY and turns it from 'works' into 'permanently unavailable'. The plan's own completeness step (T0-D Step 3.3) asks for a mirror test asserting 'every record_type LineageTracker.track can write is in the registry', but the implementation parameterizes over RECORD_TYPE_REGISTRY's keys ⇒ a model that writes lineage without being a registry member (PsvResult) can never be caught. TODO-138 registers only the TwoPhaseResult case, so this one is unregistered.

findings.title: T0-D 的 fail-closed 血缘守卫没有测试钉住「逐字同形 404」
findings.category: test coverage of a fail-closed security boundary
findings.why_it_matters:
T0-D 把「未登记类型 ⇒ 404」做成 fail-closed 的**全部目的**是：响应与「记录不存在」**逐字同形**，攻击者分辨不出「这个类型不被支持」⇒ 不成为枚举信号。本批同族用例（tests/test_lineage_api.py:104、tests/api/v1/test_lineage_guard.py:181-185）都断言 body（code + message），只有本批新加的两条未登记类型用例（test_unknown_record_type_is_404、test_registry_key_cv_result_is_404）只断言 `status_code == 404` ⇒ 将来有人把该分支的 detail 改成别的文案（例如「unsupported record type」），或让错误信封带上别的 code，**没有任何测试会红**。

同一条防线还有两处零覆盖（同一批引入的公开契约变化）：① `/upstream` 的对外形状变了 —— 未登记类型此前是 200 + []（守卫跳过 ⇒ tracker 查不到行 ⇒ 空数组），现在是 404，而**没有任何一条 /upstream 用例**覆盖未登记类型或 `record_type='streams'`（新加的 test_lineage_by_source_ref.py 只打 /graph 与 /downstream；既有 /upstream 用例全部用 已登记的 PipingResult）；② `/upstream` 里新加的 `record_type == "streams" ⇒ 200 + []` 分支（注释写明「『没有』与『查不到』是两件事」）也是零覆盖 ⇒ 有人还原旧守卫或删掉 streams 分支，都不会有测试变红。
evidence: pcs-backend/tests/api/v1/test_lineage_by_source_ref.py:563 — `    assert r.status_code == 404, r.text`

pcs-backend/app/api/v1/lineage.py:244-247 — `    entry = LINEAGE_GUARDED_RECORD_TYPES.get(record_type)` / `    if entry is None:` / `        # ⚠️ **未登记的类型 ⇒ 404**（fail-closed）—— 与「记录不存在」**逐字同形**` / `        raise HTTPException(404, "no lineage for record")`
pcs-backend/tests/api/v1/test_lineage_by_source_ref.py:574 — `    assert r.status_code == 404, r.text`（test_registry_key_cv_result_is_404，同样只断言状态码）
pcs-backend/tests/test_lineage_api.py:104 — `    assert r.json()["message"] == "no lineage for record"`（同仓既有约定：message 要钉）

pcs-backend/tests/api/v1/test_lineage_guard.py:184-185 — `    assert r_missing.json()["code"] == r_forbidden.json()["code"]` / `    assert r_missing.json()["message"] == r_forbidden.json()["message"]`
pcs-backend/app/api/v1/lineage.py:73 — `    if record_type == "streams":`（/upstream 端点里本批新增的分支，其后 `        return []`）
pcs-backend/app/api/v1/lineage.py:244-247 — `    if entry is None:` / `        raise HTTPException(404, "no lineage for record")`（本批把「跳过」改成 404 ⇒ /upstream 对未登记类型由 200+[] 变 404）
pcs-backend/tests/api/v1/test_lineage_by_source_ref.py — 全文件只出现 `/graph` 与 `/downstream` 两个 URL（grep：`/api/v1/lineage/…/graph`、`/api/v1/lineage/…/downstream`），**没有任何一条 /upstream 用例**
pcs-backend/tests/test_lineage_api.py:86 — `        f"/api/v1/lineage/PipingResult/{pipe.pipe_id}/upstream"`（既有 /upstream 用例只覆盖已登记类型 PipingResult）
findings.suggested_fix: 在 tests/api/v1/test_lineage_by_source_ref.py 里补三条：① 把两条未登记类型用例（test_unknown_record_type_is_404、test_registry_key_cv_result_is_404）改成「与不存在响应逐字同形」的断言：先取一个**已登记**类型的随机 uuid 请求得到基准 404，再断言 `r.status_code == base.status_code == 404` 且 `r.json()["code"] == base.json()["code"]` 且 `r.json()["message"] == base.json()["message"] == "no lineage for record"`；② 已授权物流的 `GET /api/v1/lineage/streams/{stream_id}/upstream` ⇒ 200 且 body == []；③ `GET /api/v1/lineage/NotARecordType/{uuid}/upstream` ⇒ 404 且 body 与基准 404 逐字相同（code + message）。

findings.title: 账簿写 roles「合并」，实现已是「覆盖」
findings.why_it_matters:
本批 T0-E 的最终实现是**覆盖**：`pcs-backend/app/services/token_issuer.py::_write_real_role` 的 docstring 明写「⚠️ **覆盖，不是合并**（整批评审 Important #1 · 2026-11-11）」并执行 `.values(roles=[role])`（只增不减会让「角色降级」永不生效 ⇒ 按 `users.roles` 圈人的通知逻辑会继续找已降级的人 —— 这正是 `.wolf/cerebrum.md` 的 Do-Not-Repeat 条目点名要避免的）。

但本批新写的两处账簿仍描述成**合并**：TODOS.md 的 TODO-134 闭环说明（已核：第 2945-2946 行确实写 「**合并**进 `users.roles`（只合并、不冲掉已有角色、不重复追加同一个角色）」）与 `.wolf/buglog.json` bug-2156 的 `fix` 字段（同一措辞），而 bug-2156 的 `fix_commit` 指向 `69b2327` —— 正是**被本批自己推翻**的那一版。

后果：① 下一个读账簿的人（或 agent）会以为「合并」才是口径，把 `_write_real_role` 改回只增不减 ⇒ 角色降级永不生效；② `fix_commit` 是 STATUS 反查「单点来源」的依据（openwolf.md 要求 `fix_commit` 必填）⇒ 反查到的代码与账簿描述对不上。覆盖的真实后果（一个持有多个角色的 `users` 行只留最近一次登录的角色 ⇒ `notification_recipients.resolve_role_recipients` 不再按被丢掉的角色选人）也没有写进任何地方。
evidence: TODOS.md:2945-2946（本批新增行）：「**本批修了什么**：`issue_tokens` 的**真实分支**在「行已存在」时把真实角色 **合并**进 `users.roles`（只合并、不冲掉已有角色、不重复追加同一个角色）。」
.wolf/buglog.json:6036（本批新增行，bug-2156 的 `fix` 字段）：「真实分支在「行已存在」时把真实角色**合并**进 `users.roles`（只合并、不冲掉已有角色、不重复追加）。」＋ :6037「"fix_commit": "69b2327"」

规则（.wolf/cerebrum.md:68-75，本批同一次改动新增的 Do-Not-Repeat 条目）：「### 角色的真值是**覆盖**，不是**合并**（2026-11-11 · P9B-4 整批评审）… ⇒ 真实登录**必须同口径覆盖** ⇒ 只增不减会让「**角色降级**」永不生效 ⇒ 旧角色一直留着 ⇒ 按 `users.roles` 圈人的通知逻辑会**继续找**已降级的人（「待办里有、点进去说你不是」比没有待办更坏）。」

实现（diff-backend-app.txt:1243-1268，pcs-backend/app/services/token_issuer.py::_write_real_role）：docstring「⚠️ **覆盖，不是合并**（整批评审 Important #1 · 2026-11-11）… ⇒ **只增不减会让「角色降级」永不生效**」，实现为 `await session.execute(update(User.__table__).where(User.__table__.c.username == username).values(roles=[role]))` ⇒ 覆盖，非合并。

规则（.claude/rules/openwolf.md）：「AFTER fixing one: log it there (error_message, root_cause, fix, fix_commit, tags). **fix_commit 必填**：修复该 bug 的 git commit 短 SHA 7 位，便于 STATUS 反查单点来源。」⇒ bug-2156 的 fix 字段与 fix_commit 必须指向**实际生效的修复**，否则反查失真。
TODOS.md:2946 - `**合并**进 `users.roles`（只合并、不冲掉已有角色、不重复追加同一个角色）。` - the TODO-134 closure text added in this diff.
pcs-backend/app/services/token_issuer.py:159 - `        .values(roles=[role])` - the implementation overwrites the whole array with a single role.
pcs-backend/app/services/token_issuer.py:140 - `⚠️ **覆盖，不是合并**（整批评审 Important #1 · 2026-11-11）：` - the code comment states the opposite of the ledger, so the contradiction is inside this diff.

Consequence for the scenario the ledger describes: a user whose users.roles row contains two roles (e.g. seeded as ['DESIGNER','CHECKER']) logs in -> the row is rewritten to ['DESIGNER'] -> notification_recipients.resolve_role_recipients, which selects by users.roles, no longer selects that user for CHECKER work. The ledger's '不冲掉已有角色' promise is exactly what prevents this, and the code does not honour it.
findings.first_evidence: TODOS.md:2945-2946（本批新增行）：「**本批修了什么**：`issue_tokens` 的**真实分支**在「行已存在」时把真实角色 **合并**进 `users.roles`（只合并、不冲掉已有角色、不重复追加同一个角色）。」
findings.suggested_fix: 把两处「合并」改成「覆盖」，并把 bug-2156 的 `fix_commit` 更新为真正落地覆盖语义的那次提交（7 位短 SHA）：① TODOS.md:2945-2946 改为「把真实角色**覆盖**写进 `users.roles`（只保留当前身份的角色 ⇒ 角色降级能生效）」并写明后果（多角色行只留最近一次登录的角色）；② `.wolf/buglog.json` 的 bug-2156 `fix` 字段同步改成覆盖口径、`fix_commit` 改成覆盖那次提交（按仓库惯例注明「原 69b2327 为合并版，已被整批评审推翻」）。顺带把 TODO-134 标题下旧的「建议改法：…**合并**真实角色」（TODOS.md:2963，pre-existing 原文）标注为「已被覆盖口径取代」，避免同一节里两套口径并存。

findings.title: _stream_graph 重复查 Stream，守卫返回值被丢弃

findings.why_it_matters:
本批给 `_guard_record_access` 加了返回值，并在 docstring 里写明「返回查到的**记录行**（调用方要拿它的字段时不必再查一次）」—— 但三个端点全都把返回值丢掉，`_stream_graph` 又 `session.get(Stream, stream_id)` 取了一遍 ⇒ 新增的返回值契约是**死的**（读代码的人会以为它被用上了）。

findings.title: 重试/提交已成功但列表刷新失败 ⇒ 报成「批量提交失败」
findings.why_it_matters:
hook 的 submit() 把「提交请求」与「提交后的列表刷新（onDone）」放在同一个 try 里、共用一个 catch。onDone 一旦 reject（网络抖动、页面卸载、调用方自己的 load 未来改成会抛），catch 会 `setResult(null)`（把刚拿到的批次摘要弹窗关掉）并把异常 rethrow 给页面 ⇒ 页面顶部显示「批量提交校对失败」，而批次其实已经提交成功。用户据此重发整批 ⇒ 重复提交（后端会返回 already_in_approval 幂等提示，但用户先看到的是「失败」，且失败清单已被清空）。

这与 hook 自己的 docstring 明写的语义（「批次**整批**失败（网络 / 超限 / 403）⇒ **抛给调用方**」）和 catch 里的注释（「整批失败 ⇒ 没有新摘要」）不一致 —— 现在的实现把「刷新失败」也算成了「整批失败」。今天唯一消费者 StreamListPage 传的 onDone 是 load()，而 load 自己吞掉了所有异常 ⇒ 这条路径目前是潜伏的，不是活跃故障；但它是一颗装在失败路径上的地雷：下一次有人让 load 抛出（或者换一个消费者），错误文案会立刻开始撒谎。
evidence: pcs-frontend/src/pages/sim/hooks/useStreamBatchSubmit.ts:81 — `      await onDoneRef.current?.();`

pcs-frontend/src/pages/sim/hooks/useStreamBatchSubmit.ts:82-86 — `    } catch (err) {` / `      // ⚠️ 整批失败 ⇒ 没有新摘要（留着旧的会**误导**用户）` / `      setResult(null);` / `      // ⚠️ **不吞异常** ⇒ 页面负责显示（403 要说「无权提交」）` / `      throw err;`
